title: Kuro 16x
description: Presenting Kuro - a black PVP Pack witch a purple twist
body:
## Kuro 16x
is a Black PVP Texture Pack with a Purple Twist. It has a unique look for almost your whole world diffrent from Vanilla but not oversimplefied
# Including
-  Armor
-  Swords
-  Tools
-  Blocks (Most important block for PVP and Evironment)
-  Skies (Night/Day)
  
Pack icon inspired by Chr7st
Some Blocks inspired by xFlyne
